task_text: A guest is coming over in 15 minutes. The house should feel welcoming — somewhere comfortable to sit, and something to offer them when they arrive.

central_instructions.R1: Prepare a light snack or beverage by picking up a light object from the kitchen and pass it to R2.
central_instructions.R2: Arrange the living room by pushing furniture to create a comfortable seating area and receive the snack or beverage from R1 to place it on the table.
central_instructions.R3: Ensure the bedroom is tidy and assist in passing any light objects needed from the bedroom to the living room.
central_instructions.R4: Check the bathroom for cleanliness and pass any light objects needed to R2 in the living room.

agent_plans.R1:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the mug from the sink basin. (r1_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [PASS] Pass the mug to R2. (r1_s2)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive the mug from R1. (r2_s1)

[10-15 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Place the mug on the table for the guest. (r2_s2)
agent_plans.R2:
[0-5 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Push the armchairs closer to the sofa to create a comfortable seating area. (r2_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Adjust the coffee table to be centered in front of the seating area. (r2_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R1 [PASS] Bring a snack or beverage to R2. (r1_s1)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive the snack or beverage from R1. (r2_s3)
- R2 [LOCAL] Place the snack or beverage on the coffee table. (r2_s4)
agent_plans.R3:
## Plan

[0-5 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Tidy the bed by arranging pillows and smoothing the sheets. (r3_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up any light objects (e.g., books, small decor) from the dresser to make it look tidy. (r3_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R3 [PASS] Carry a light object (e.g., a book or small decor) to the living room to enhance the welcoming atmosphere. (r3_s3)
agent_plans.R4:
[0-5 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Check the bathroom for cleanliness. (r4_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Open the cabinet to access light objects. (r4_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Pick up toilet paper from the cabinet. (r4_s3)
- R4 [PASS] Pass the toilet paper to R2 in the living room. (r4_s4)
